investigation.title: LUM-811: Issue created: VAT invoice exports show blank totals
investigation.escalationText:
This is Bright Market's formal escalation on LUM-811 (VAT invoice exports show blank totals).

The totals have been blank since your 5.3.0 upgrade four weeks ago. We were told the fix would ship in the Sep 20 release; instead your bot announced 5.3.3 fixes and the ticket was closed while our finance sandbox still showed blank exports. Our chases on the 22nd and 23rd went unanswered.

Please explain what happened and when this was actually fixed.

Dana Okafor, Finance Lead, Bright Market
investigation.plan:
Bright Market's escalation on LUM-811 alleges VAT invoice export totals have been blank since the 5.3.0 upgrade, that a promised Sep 20 fix was not delivered, that 5.3.3 was announced and the ticket closed while the finance sandbox still showed blank exports, and that chases on the 22nd and 23rd went unanswered. The investigators' job is to reconstruct the timeline and decision trail for LUM-811 across Jira and email, determine what was actually fixed in which version, and explain the gap between the client's experience and our records — without asserting answers here.

Hypotheses to test:
- The blank VAT totals were caused by a specific code change in 5.3.0 (referenced as a rounding/refactor change) and the LUM-811 timeline reflects when that cause was identified versus when a real fix shipped. — test: Read the full LUM-811 Jira history and any cross-referenced ticket where the cause was first noted; line up status transitions (Open→In Progress→Resolved→Reopened) against version numbers 5.3.0/5.3.3/5.3.4 and the fix announcements.; falsify: If LUM-811 history shows the cause identified only at/after 5.3.4, or shows the blank-totals cause tied to something other than a 5.3.0 change, the 'known cause, late fix' framing fails.
- LUM-811 was marked Resolved (and 5.3.3 announced as a fix) before the client's finance sandbox evidence showed the problem was actually gone, i.e. resolution was premature relative to verification. — test: Compare the Resolved timestamp and the 5.3.3 announcement date against any client sandbox reports and the subsequent Reopen event; check whether any verification step (sandbox check, client confirm) preceded the Resolve.; falsify: If evidence shows a documented sandbox verification confirmed working exports before the Resolve and the client later reported blanks, then resolution was validated and the cause lies elsewhere (e.g. environment or a regression).
- The Sep 20 release promise and the client's chases on the 22nd and 23rd were not answered or reconciled by support, causing the escalation; the actual fixing ship was 5.3.4, not the Sep 20 release or 5.3.3. — test: Search email and Jira for the Sep 20 commitment message, any inbound messages from the client on 22–23 Sep, and replies (or absence of replies); map which version was stated as the fix at each point.; falsify: If records show a reply to the 22nd/23rd chases, or show the Sep 20 release did carry a fix that later regressed, the 'unanswered chases and wrong fix version' framing weakens.
- There was confusion between two issues (LUM-811 and LUM-804, and a 'billing-v2'/'KESTREL' workstream) so fixes announced for one were assumed to cover the other, contributing to the mismatch between announced 5.3.3 fixes and the still-blank client sandbox. — test: Read LUM-804 and any billing-v2/KESTREL references, and trace how LUM-811 was linked to or decoupled from that work; check statements that the billing-v2 piece is 'separate'.; falsify: If LUM-804 and billing-v2 never touched the VAT export path and no fix announcement conflated them with LUM-811, this confusion hypothesis fails.

People to look at: Nadia Chen, Dana Okafor, Priya Nair, Ravi Menon, Alex Weinstein

Unknowns to keep open:
- Exact date and content of the 'Sep 20 release' promise — who made it and what was committed.
- What specifically was claimed fixed in 5.3.3 versus 5.3.4, and the actual ship dates of each build.
- Whether any message was sent replying to the client's 22–23 Sep chases, and if so by whom.
- Result of any sandbox verification before the Resolve on 21 Sep and the Reopen on 26 Sep.
- Whether the LUM-804 / billing-v2 (KESTREL) change is on the same code path as LUM-811's VAT rounding.
- Whether 5.3.4 was actually released and confirmed as fixing the client's finance sandbox exports (the last event asserts this; needs corroboration from the client side).
- Why the ticket was closed/announced via automation ('your bot') and whether that automated closure bypassed normal verification.
- Whether 'four weeks ago' (client's 5.3.0 upgrade timing) aligns with internal release dates.

events.text: On 4 Sep, Priya Nair told the client the work was being tracked in 5.3.3 while stating the billing-v2 piece was separate — an early 5.3.3 fix-version expectation that later did not hold.

events.headline: Priya Nair told the client on 2024-09-04 that "the billing-v2…
events.text: Priya Nair told the client on 2024-09-04 that "the billing-v2 piece is separate" from LUM-811, but the later root-cause note ties LUM-811's blank totals to the billing-v2/KESTREL VAT rounding change — an internal inconsistency between the decoupled LUM-811 workstream and the actual cause.

events.headline: Root cause was recorded under LUM-804 (the KESTREL/billing-v2 refactor ticket…
events.text: Root cause was recorded under LUM-804 (the KESTREL/billing-v2 refactor ticket created by Alex Weinstein on 10 Sep), not LUM-811, so the cause of LUM-811 lived outside the customer-facing ticket.

events.headline: Work on LUM-811 sat in Open from creation on 2…
events.text: Work on LUM-811 sat in Open from creation on 2 Sep until Ravi Menon moved it to In Progress on 18 Sep, a 16-day period with no recorded triage progress.

events.headline: On 2024-09-18 Ravi Menon again stated the fix was scheduled…
events.text: On 2024-09-18 Ravi Menon again stated the fix was scheduled for the Sep 20 release and asked which finance sandbox the export came from.

events.headline: Ravi Menon recorded in LUM-811 on 2024-09-18 that the "Fix…
events.text: Ravi Menon recorded in LUM-811 on 2024-09-18 that the "Fix is scheduled for the Sep 20 release" and asked the reporter to confirm which finance sandbox the export came from; the Sep 20 release did not resolve the issue (no Sep 20 confirmation per the client, and the ticket was resolved on 21 Sep against 5.3.3, then reopened on 26 Sep).

events.headline: Ravi Menon repeated the Sep 20 fix schedule in Jira…
events.text: Ravi Menon repeated the Sep 20 fix schedule in Jira on 18 Sep and asked the client which finance sandbox the export came from, but no client answer to that question appears in the records.

events.headline: Priya Nair resolved LUM-811 (In Progress → Resolved) on 21…
events.text: Priya Nair resolved LUM-811 (In Progress → Resolved) on 21 Sep, before the 26 Sep reopen that established the sandbox totals were still blank.

events.headline: LUM-811 moved In Progress → Resolved on 2024-09-21, before the…
events.text: LUM-811 moved In Progress → Resolved on 2024-09-21, before the client's finance sandbox was checked: the reopen on 26 Sep recorded totals still blank, showing the resolution was premature relative to client-side verification.

events.headline: LUM-811 was marked Resolved on 2024-09-21 by Priya Nair as…
events.text: LUM-811 was marked Resolved on 2024-09-21 by Priya Nair as fixed by the 5.3.3 rollout based only on internal verification ('our side'), with no client sandbox confirmation recorded before the resolution.

events.headline: Priya Nair stated on 2024-09-21 that LUM-811 was "Resolved with…
events.text: Priya Nair stated on 2024-09-21 that LUM-811 was "Resolved with the 5.3.3 rollout; exports verified on our side" — an internal-verification claim that was not kept: the finance sandbox totals were still blank when re-checked on 26 Sep and the real fix was 5.3.4.

events.headline: LUM-811 was moved to Resolved on 21 Sep on the…
events.text: LUM-811 was moved to Resolved on 21 Sep on the strength of internal verification only ('exports verified on our side'), with no client or finance-sandbox confirmation documented before closure.

events.headline: Nadia Chen reassigned LUM-811 from Alex Weinstein to Ravi Menon…
events.text: Nadia Chen reassigned LUM-811 from Alex Weinstein to Ravi Menon on 22 Sep — the day after the ticket had already been marked Resolved — indicating ownership was unsettled after the premature closure.

events.headline: The blank VAT export totals were caused by the KESTREL…
events.text: The blank VAT export totals were caused by the KESTREL refactor (billing-v2), which moved VAT rounding to integer math in 5.3.0 and dropped fractional cents, blanking totals on export; the change was still unreviewed.

events.headline: The blank VAT totals were traced to the KESTREL/billing-v2 refactor…
events.text: The blank VAT totals were traced to the KESTREL/billing-v2 refactor that moved VAT rounding to integer math in 5.3.0, a change recorded as still unreviewed; Nadia Chen noted this while triaging LUM-811.

events.headline: Root cause recorded by Nadia Chen on LUM-804 (2024-09-22): the…
events.text: Root cause recorded by Nadia Chen on LUM-804 (2024-09-22): the KESTREL refactor (billing-v2) moved VAT rounding to integer math in 5.3.0, which drops fractional cents and blanks the export totals, and that change was still unreviewed — a cause in a 5.3.0 change, identified only on 22 Sep, after LUM-811 had already been resolved against 5.3.3.

events.headline: The client's 2024-09-23 message notes it was the fourth follow-up…
events.text: The client's 2024-09-23 message notes it was the fourth follow-up since Sep 2 with no confirmation on Sep 20; the email record contains no lumen-side reply to it until Nadia Chen's 2024-09-26 message.

events.headline: Bright Market's 23 Sep email recorded a fourth follow-up since…
events.text: Bright Market's 23 Sep email recorded a fourth follow-up since Sep 2 with no confirmation on the promised Sep 20 release.

events.headline: On 2024-09-23 the client sent a fourth follow-up since 2…
events.text: On 2024-09-23 the client sent a fourth follow-up since 2 Sep noting no confirmation on the Sep 20 release; no reply from Lumen to this chase appears in the registry — Lumen's next message was Nadia Chen's internal-investigation note on 26 Sep.

events.headline: The real fix shipped in 5.3.4, announced by Nadia Chen…
events.text: The real fix shipped in 5.3.4, announced by Nadia Chen on 2024-09-26 as 'Fixed properly in 5.3.4 tomorrow' and recorded in LUM-811 on 2024-09-28 as the VAT rounding path corrected with exports verified with finance.

events.headline: Nadia Chen committed on 2024-09-26 that the VAT rounding root…
events.text: Nadia Chen committed on 2024-09-26 that the VAT rounding root cause was found and "Fixed properly in 5.3.4 tomorrow", i.e. 5.3.4 on 27 Sep; the 28 Sep records report 5.3.4 shipped with the VAT rounding path corrected, consistent with that promise.

events.headline: As late as 26 Sep, the real root cause had…
events.text: As late as 26 Sep, the real root cause had only just been identified and the actual fix was moved to 5.3.4 — not the Sep 20 release and not 5.3.3.

events.headline: The 5.3.3 fix did not work: on 2024-09-26 Nadia Chen…
events.text: The 5.3.3 fix did not work: on 2024-09-26 Nadia Chen reopened LUM-811 after re-checking the finance sandbox and finding VAT layout totals still blank.

events.headline: Nadia Chen reopened LUM-811 on 26 Sep after re-checking the…
events.text: Nadia Chen reopened LUM-811 on 26 Sep after re-checking the finance sandbox and finding the VAT totals still blank, showing the 21 Sep Resolve and 5.3.3 rollout had not fixed the client's problem.

events.headline: On 2024-09-26 Nadia Chen reopened LUM-811 after re-checking the finance…
events.text: On 2024-09-26 Nadia Chen reopened LUM-811 after re-checking the finance sandbox and finding totals still blank on VAT layouts — confirming the 5.3.3 fix announced on 21 Sep did not resolve the client's issue.

events.headline: Client-side confirmation of the 5.3.4 fix came on 28 Sep,…
events.text: Client-side confirmation of the 5.3.4 fix came on 28 Sep, after the escalation, with Bright Market noting the imports were verified but took longer than it should have (the message says 'Imports', not exports).

events.headline: Client-side corroboration that the fix landed: on 2024-09-28 Dana Okafor…
events.text: Client-side corroboration that the fix landed: on 2024-09-28 Dana Okafor reported "Imports verified" while noting it took longer than it should have, indicating the VAT export path was working after 5.3.4.

events.headline: Bright Market's 2024-09-28 escalation states the totals had been blank…
events.text: Bright Market's 2024-09-28 escalation states the totals had been blank since the 5.3.0 upgrade, that the fix was promised for the Sep 20 release, that 5.3.3 fixes were announced and the ticket closed while the finance sandbox still showed blanks, and that the 22nd/23rd chases went unanswered.

events.headline: The client's chases on the 22nd and 23rd went unanswered…
events.text: The client's chases on the 22nd and 23rd went unanswered — the only inbound emails in the 21–24 Sep window are the client's own, with no internal reply recorded before Nadia Chen's 26 Sep email.

events.headline: Bright Market's escalation of 2024-09-28 asserts the gap between records…
events.text: Bright Market's escalation of 2024-09-28 asserts the gap between records and experience: they were told the Sep 20 release would carry the fix, but an automated bot announcement of 5.3.3 fixes and the ticket closure occurred while their finance sandbox still showed blank exports, and their 22–23 Sep chases went unanswered.

events.headline: LUM-811 was set In Progress → Resolved a second time…
events.text: LUM-811 was set In Progress → Resolved a second time on 2024-09-28 by Nadia Chen, seven days after the first (premature) resolution; this second closure follows the 5.3.4 fix and client verification.

events.headline: Final resolution on 2024-09-28 records the fix as the 5.3.4…
events.text: Final resolution on 2024-09-28 records the fix as the 5.3.4 correction of the VAT rounding path with exports verified with finance, confirming 5.3.4 — not the Sep 20 release or 5.3.3 — was the fixing ship.

events.headline: LUM-811 was finally resolved on 28 Sep as fixed in…
events.text: LUM-811 was finally resolved on 28 Sep as fixed in 5.3.4, with the VAT rounding path corrected and exports verified with finance.

events.headline: LUM-811's real fix shipped in 5.3.4, not the Sep 20…
events.text: LUM-811's real fix shipped in 5.3.4, not the Sep 20 release or 5.3.3: Nadia Chen closed the ticket on 2024-09-28 stating the VAT rounding path was corrected in 5.3.4 and exports verified with finance.
